{{Quote|If we add it, we can make twice as much tea at twice the profit.|Moogan [[Tee Va/Legends|Tee Va]], on adding [[Slabin/Legends|slabin]] to tea|<ref name="Corruption" />}}
'''Moogans''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mooga/Legends|Mooga]], located in the [[Perkell sector/Legends|Perkell sector]]. They were on average taller than [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. Members of the species had [[Limb/Legends|hands]] and feet with four digits each, as well as [[Color/Legends|green]] skin. Some Moogans had a proclivity for wearing headdresses, tunics and sandals.

A group of Moogans led by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Tee Va/Legends|Tee Va]] arrived on the planet [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to distribute [[Ardees Beverage/Legends|bottled tea]] with a [[Slabin/Legends|chemical]] introduced on-planet. That substance diluted the [[Tea/Legends|tea]] and thus increased the Moogans' profits. However, the mixture, when introduced to the populace, [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] some of the [[Youngling/Legends|children]] in the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]]. The Moogans' plans were thwarted by an investigation headed by the [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] of Mandalore, [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]], and visiting [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]; the smugglers were subsequently arrested.

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:MooganGunship-Corruption.png|thumb|left|180px|Moogan smuggler [[Shekelesh-class freight gunship/Legends|''Shekelesh''-class freight gunship]]]]
Moogans were tall, thin, bipedal [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]]. Typically [[Color/Legends|green]] in color, the [[Species/Legends|species]] exhibited dark-green mottling on their faces and [[Limb/Legends|limbs]]. Their faces were slender, with pronounced cheek [[Bone/Legends|bones]] and accentuated brows. They possessed long necks, four-fingered hands, four-toed feet, and sharpened [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]].<ref name="Corruption" />

==Society and culture==
{{Quote|It must be a clerical oversight. I'm sure it won't happen&mdash;again.|Moogan Tee Va, while bribing a customs official|<ref name="Corruption" />}}
Some members of the Moogan species wore headdresses, tunics, and sandals, particularly those of [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Tee Va/Legends|Tee Va's]] group. Moogans were not against committing bribery, [[Poison/Legends|poisoning]], and other crimes to achieve their goals due to their inherent greed.<ref name="UK">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.15|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic 6.15]]</ref> They were capable of learning to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]]. Tee Va's smuggling crew preferred [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] as a form of self-defense and hired [[Gotal/Legends|Gotals]] to serve them on missions. The group transported their cargoes in a giant, ovoid<ref name="Corruption" /> [[Shekelesh-class freight gunship/Legends|''Shekelesh''-class freight gunship]], which was capable of walking on mechanical legs upon reaching a surface.<ref name="TCW Incredible Vehicles">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]''</ref>

==History==
The Moogans hailed from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mooga/Legends|Mooga]],<ref name="Corruption" /> in the [[Mooga system/Legends|Mooga system]] of the [[Perkell sector/Legends|Perkell sector]], located along the northeastern border of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref><ref name="TEAOC-Note">The location of the planet [[Mooga/Legends|Mooga]] is based on its [[Sector/Legends|sector]] placement and grid number in [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion's]] appendix, and from the placement of the [[Perkell sector/Legends|Perkell sector]] on the Online Companion's [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] sector map.</ref> Mooga, while not positioned far from the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], was largely ignored by the blossoming [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] until some point between [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] and [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]]. Around [[3956 BBY]], the planet was in [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] territory controlled by [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]]. As the [[Standard year/Legends|centuries]] progressed up to the [[Ruusan campaign]], Mooga continued its existence on the borders of Sith [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and unaligned territory.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

[[File:MoogansArriveOnMandalore-Corruption.png|thumb|right|200px|The Moogans arrive on Mandalore.]]
By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], their planet fell under the control of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] and became integrated into [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.<ref name="Corruption" /><ref name="TEA" /> Officials from the planet [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], which had its supply lines cut due to its neutral stance against the war, began communicating with the Moogans in order to [[Mandalorian black market conspiracy/Legends|smuggle]] products to the surface and establish a [[Black market/Legends|black market]].<ref name="Academy">{{TCW|The Academy}}</ref> The smuggling ring was identified and decimated by [[Mandalorian Guard/Legends|Mandalorian Guard]], led by the [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] of Mandalore, [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]], and a visiting Republic [[Senator/Legends|senator]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="Corruption" /> The criminal operation was ultimately linked to [[Almec/Legends|Almec]], the [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]].<ref name="Academy" />

After the fall of the Republic, Moogan space was surrounded by worlds under the control of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and remained so for the duration of the Empire's presence in those territories. By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the Empire had fractured into several rival territories. The [[Greater Maldrood]] was one of the outlying regions; it incorporated space surrounding Mooga and held it until the territory's fragmentation between [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]] and [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], after which, Mooga's region was considered to lay within the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]]. The Perkell [[Sector/Legends|sector]] existed for several years, split between Imperial and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] interests until the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], during which many worlds surrounding Mooga were attacked and conquered by the invading [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. The space surrounding the Mooga system again fell under Sith control by [[137 ABY]], with the rise of [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Moogans in the galaxy==
[[File:Moogan-firefight.png|thumb|left|250px|Moogans led by Tee Va shoot out with forces on Mandalore.]]
{{Quote|Welcome back, gentlemen. I'm here for my inspection.''"<br />"''Certainly. We would expect nothing less.|A transaction between a customs official and the smugglers|<ref name="Corruption" />}}
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Annual2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> smugglers led by the Moogan Tee Va and assisted by Gotals came to the New Mandalorian [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]], where they distributed [[Ardees Beverage/Legends|bottled tea]] diluted with a hazardous chemical, [[Slabin/Legends|slabin]]; the resulting admixture thus doubled their profits. All the while, the smugglers paid off the on-planet [[Unidentified Mandalorian customs official/Legends|customs officials]] to distribute the product and overlook the illicit operation.<ref name="Corruption" /><ref name="EpGuide" /> The mixture ended up in the hands of countless Sundari [[Youngling/Legends|schoolchildren]], who became sick and were [[Medcenter/Legends|hospitalized]] across the city and the planet.<ref name="Corruption" />

The Moogans returned a few days later with another shipment of tea and once again bribed customs with [[Credit ingot/Legends|Republic credit ingots]]. Two Mandalorian [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] were used as guards for the [[Sundari dock warehouse/Legends|dock warehouse]] in which the Moogans mixed the slabin with the tea. When the Moogans were discovered by Duchess Satine Kryze and Senator Padmé Amidala, Tee Va and his crew [[Skirmish at the Sundari docks/Legends|took up arms]] against the accompanying [[Mandalorian Guard/Legends|Mandalorian Guard]] forces and [[Mandalorian Royal Guard/Legends|Mandalorian Royal Guard]]. The Moogans and their Gotal counterparts took down a [[Unidentified Mandalorian police captain (Sundari)|police captain]] and two Royal Guards. However, the victory was short-lived, as Amidala and the remaining Royal Guard pushed forward a shipping container and closed in on the smugglers' position, killing one [[Unidentified Moogan crew member|Moogan crew member]] and a few Gotals. The surviving smugglers and assisting Mandalorians were arrested, and the smuggled products were subsequently destroyed with [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]] by the order of Satine.<ref name="Corruption" />

[[File:Zygerria-moogan3.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A Moogan along with others on Zygerria.]]
Sometime during the Clone Wars but after the corruption on Mandalore had abated, Moogans were present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]], during its time as a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] world. One Moogan walked by a disguised [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who were on their way to infiltrate the government. Another Moogan conversed with a [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] trader in the same alley. Later, during the Zygerrian slave trade auction, a Moogan stood by a monitor and exclaimed when [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was revealed as a new potential slave.<ref name="SOTR">{{TCW|Slaves of the Republic}}</ref>

Some months later, c. 20 BBY, Tee Va and his Moogan shipmates were once again transporting materials to and from [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].<ref name="The Lawless">{{TCW|The Lawless}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The only appearances of Moogans have been in material surrounding the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, including two episodes in the program's [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]], which originally aired in [[2010]], and in the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] [[Star Wars video games|video game]]. In [[October]] 2010, a three-piece outfit of headdress, robe, and sandals marketed as belonging to Tee Va was available for players to purchase piece-by-piece. The items marked the first appearance of the smuggler's name.<ref name="CWA: Intergalactic News">{{WebCite|url=http://www.clonewarsadventures.com/articles/014_1_newmandogear.html|text=Clone Wars Adventures: Intergalactic News|work=clonewarsadventures.com|archivedate=20101019034724}}</ref> The species' name and a brief backstory were provided by the [[StarWars.com]] [http://www.starwars.com/theclonewars/guide/episode305.html episode guide] for ''The Clone Wars'' episode "[[Corruption (episode)|Corruption]]." Their home planet of Mooga was placed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] via [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]]. Later, the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.15|Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic UK 6.15]]'' mentioned the Moogans in its contents.

The clothing of Tee Va's group of Moogans resembles that of the [[Wikipedia:Ancient Egypt|ancient Egyptians]], especially their pharaoh-like metallic headdresses.<ref name="EpGuide" />
